items.title: Building an AI Text Detector From Scratch
items.summary: Substack recently launched its AI detector feature in the UI, which is super interesting. Separately, lots of people asked me about interesting local do-it-yourself LLM projects as demos to show what small language models (SLMs) are capable of. Putting one and one together, I thought it would be interesting to show how an AI detector can be implemented. I will also use it as a verifier to train a small language model
